reading.ru: Помни, как Господь, твой Бог, вел тебя через пустыню все эти сорок лет, смиряя и испытывая тебя, чтобы узнать, что в твоем сердце.
reading.question: What was the purpose of God leading Israel through the wilderness for forty years?
options: To punish them for their sins
To test and humble them to know their hearts
To make them stronger warriors
To hide them from their enemies
reading.correct: To test and humble them to know their hearts
reading.explain: The text states 'смиряя и испытывая тебя, чтобы узнать, что в твоем сердце' (humbling and testing you to know what is in your heart).

reading.ru: не одним хлебом живет человек, но и каждым словом, исходящим из уст Господа.
reading.question: According to the text, what sustains a person besides bread?
options: Water and wine
Every word proceeding from the mouth of God
Meat and fruits
Sleep and rest
reading.correct: Every word proceeding from the mouth of God
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'не одним хлебом живет человек, но и каждым словом, исходящим из уст Господа' (man does not live by bread alone, but by every word from God's mouth).

reading.ru: Твоя одежда не изнашивалась, и твои ноги не опухали все эти сорок лет.
reading.question: What miracle occurred regarding the Israelites' clothing and feet during the wilderness journey?
options: They never had to wash their clothes
Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell
They received new clothes annually
Their feet never touched the ground
reading.correct: Their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell
reading.explain: The text says 'Твоя одежда не изнашивалась, и твои ноги не опухали' (Your clothes did not wear out and your feet did not swell).

reading.ru: Господь твой Бог вводит тебя в благодатную землю, землю с многоводными реками и водоемами, с источниками.
reading.question: What characteristics define the land God is giving to the Israelites?
options: A dry desert with sparse vegetation
A good land with many streams and springs of water
A mountainous region with no agriculture
An island surrounded by sea
reading.correct: A good land with many streams and springs of water
reading.explain: The text describes 'благодатную землю, землю с многоводными реками и водоемами, с источниками' (good land with streams and springs).

reading.ru: Когда ты поешь и насытишься, тогда славь Господа своего Бога за ту благодатную землю, которую Он дал тебе.
reading.question: When should you bless the Lord for the good land?
options: Before you eat anything
When you have eaten and are satisfied
Only on religious festival days
Never, because the land is naturally fertile
reading.correct: When you have eaten and are satisfied
reading.explain: The text states 'Когда ты поешь и насытишься, тогда славь Господа' (When you have eaten and are satisfied, then bless the Lord).

reading.ru: Но помни Господа твоего Бога, потому что это Он дает тебе возможность приобретать богатство.
reading.question: Who is credited with giving the ability to acquire wealth?
options: Your own strength and skill
Your family inheritance
The Lord your God
Foreign merchants and traders
reading.explain: The text clearly states 'Он дает тебе возможность приобретать богатство' (He gives you the ability to acquire wealth).
